name: claude-broker
label: Claude Broker (AI)
description: Send AI prompts to Claude Code sessions attached to a local claude-broker daemon. Configures the session pools the CMS AI module can use.
author: Surge CMS

configSchema.label: Broker URL
configSchema.help: The claude-broker daemon's HTTP address (usually on the same server).

configSchema.label: Claude Code path
configSchema.help: Absolute path to the claude CLI on the server. Empty = found automatically (~/.local/bin, PATH).

configSchema.label: Session working folder
configSchema.help: Folder the broker sessions start in. Empty = the plugin's data folder (an empty folder — sessions get no project files).

configSchema.label: Broker socket
configSchema.help: The daemon's unix socket the sessions' shim connects to. Empty = /tmp/claude-broker.sock.

configSchema.label: Pools
configSchema.help: Session pools: [{ name, count, description }]. A pool is a session label; members are labelled <name> or <name>-<n>.

configSchema.label: Frame prompts
configSchema.help: Add the ▶ KIND header and the complete_job footer to every prompt.

configSchema.label: Gap between jobs to one session (ms)
